name: io.github.flujo-app/mcp-virtual-computer
title: MCP Virtual Computer
description: A persistent Docker or Fly computer rendered as a Three.js laptop, with an optional live Xfce desktop.

environmentVariables.name: BACKEND
environmentVariables.description: Computer provider. Use docker for a local container or fly for a permanent Fly Machine.

environmentVariables.name: COMPUTER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Stable identity of the one persistent computer.

environmentVariables.name: DESKTOP_ENVIRONMENT
environmentVariables.description: Start the real Xfce desktop instead of the virtual desktop.

environmentVariables.name: NETWORK_ACCESS
environmentVariables.description: Allow outbound network access from the computer.

environmentVariables.name: AUTO_INSTALL_DOCKER
environmentVariables.description: On Windows, install and start Docker Desktop lazily when needed.

environmentVariables.name: AUTO_INSTALL_FLYCTL
environmentVariables.description: Download flyctl into the user profile when it is missing.

environmentVariables.name: FLY_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional Fly API token. A cached flyctl login is also supported.

environmentVariables.name: EXPOSE_LIFECYCLE_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Also expose runtime status and network/desktop switching tools to the model. The MCP App can always use them.
